content.text: {"core": "Flourishing lets a thing rest in its own good condition — tended, settled, enough as it stands. In Nurturing, it works on the growing itself: what has come up gets to arrive and hold. Overdone, resting hardens into guarding — the settled state gets fenced and polished until nothing new is permitted to grow, and keeping it perfect starves the ground.", "sheetLine": "The garden is kept so perfectly that nothing is allowed to grow in it."}
